shell.drawerDescription: Links to the pages of the app.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.description: Changes cannot be saved until your connection is back.

section.title: Your profile
section.description: How you appear to other members, and the language of the app.

email.label: Email
email.description: The address you sign in with.

language.label: Language
language.description: The language of the app and of the emails we send you.

loadFailed.title: Your profile could not be loaded
loadFailed.description: Try again. If this continues, tell your administrator.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: How the app looks and how bookmark lists open.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: System follows the setting of your device.

accent.label: Accent colour
accent.description: Colours buttons, switches and the focus ring.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard
shortcuts.description: Shortcuts that hold Ctrl or Command always work.

single.label: Single-key shortcuts
single.description: Act with one key, for example C to create a bookmark. Turn this off if keys are triggered by accident.

ai.title: AI suggestions
ai.description: This server can suggest titles, tags and folders for your bookmarks.

optOut.label: Don't use AI suggestions for me
optOut.description: No bookmark of yours is sent to the AI service.

loadFailed.title: Your preferences could not be loaded
Your security settings could not be loaded

password.title: Password
password.description: Change the password you sign in with. Your other sessions are signed out when you do.

new.label: New password
new.description: Use at least 12 characters. A long phrase works well.

password.changed: Your password was changed. Your other sessions were signed out.

error.currentWrong: The current password is not right.
error.breached: This password appeared in a known data breach. Choose another one.

none.title: This account has no password
none.description: You sign in through an identity provider. Adding a password is not available yet.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: The devices you are signed in on. Revoke a session you do not recognise.

loadFailed.title: Your sessions could not be loaded

current.title: Sign out of this device?
current.description: This ends the session you are using now. You will need to sign in again.

others.title: Sign out everywhere else?
others.description: Every other session of your account is signed out. This device stays signed in.

configFailure.title: The app could not be loaded
configFailure.description: The settings of this server could not be read. Reload the page, and tell your administrator if this continues.

notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
notFound.description: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved.

forbidden.title: You don't have access
forbidden.description: You are not a member of this workspace, or this page is only for administrators.

serverError.title: Something went wrong
serverError.description: This page could not be shown. Reload it, and tell your administrator if this continues.

mutationFailed.title: The change was not saved
mutationFailed.description: Try again. If this continues, tell your administrator.
mutationFailed.offline: You are offline. Check your connection and try again.

error.credentials: The email address or the password is wrong.
error.invalid: Check your entries and try again.
error.unavailable: Signing in is not possible right now. Try again in a moment.

rateLimited.unknown: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again later.
rateLimited.seconds: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {count, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
rateLimited.minutes: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.

failed.description: Signing out did not work. Try again.

reauth.title: Confirm it is you
